description: Focus hidden behind opaque content and focus held where nothing else can be reached, and the controls that only look like it.

mustFind.why: an in-flow opaque panel covers three tabbable links (cihanca.com, field item F1)

exactly four stops fail: a nameless link that only has a box while focused, a clipped skip link with text that stays 1x1 focused, and a link named only through a two-id aria-labelledby, and a button with outline:none; the nextjs-portal overlay, the 0x0 span and the off-screen skip link with an outline are not reported
two fields hold focus with Tab and Shift+Tab and nothing else is focusable, so focus never returns to the page (Frameva, field item F23)

mustNotFind.why: an opacity:0 checkbox and a full-opacity one under its label, a transparent click-catcher, a sticky header with scroll-padding, and links in an opacity:0 menu and a height:0 overflow:hidden panel
zero-size overlay, 0x0 span and an off-screen skip link are not covered content
one button; the next Tab leaves the page and focus comes back
a role="dialog" cookie wall without aria-modal holds focus among its four controls and ignores Escape: a modal dialog, not a trap
